MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

4. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. Solve for x: x + 5 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 5
   C. 5
   D. 4

6. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 5
   C. 37
   D. 13

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 5

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 12

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

13. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

14. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

16. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 16

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
